Card Q&A.a: Yes, as long as either a Digimon card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano] is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include 1 card with the [Bagra Army] trait or a [Yuu Amano], can I still add a card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with the [Bagra Army] trait and a [Yuu Amano] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Bagra Army] in one of its traits and 1 [Yuu Amano] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] When an effect trashes this digivolution card, gain 1 memory.
